visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens on a large table in a restaurant with bright indoor lighting, featuring a split hotpot with white and green broths surrounded by plates of shrimp, clams, squid, raw beef, and leafy green vegetables like bok choy. (2) A person's hand, wearing a dark jacket, uses golden tongs to pick up a slice of marbled raw red beef from a black tray, showcasing the meat's physical texture. (3) The scene shifts to a buffet station where fried golden buns and spring rolls are being handled with tongs; the background shows warm-toned lights and typical restaurant decor. (4) A handheld camera pans across refrigerated buffet shelves displaying various types of fresh leafy vegetables, corn, and meatballs in labeled plastic containers. (5) A ladle serves curry fish balls and gelatinous pieces of duck blood from large clay pots, while a hand picks up noodles and pours small snacks into a bowl. (6) Close-ups show soft-serve ice cream being swirled and tea being dispensed from a machine into a stainless steel cup. (7) Ladles stir a creamy white garlic broth and a green broth containing large pieces of century egg and cilantro. (8) The camera captures more raw meat and seafood before showing customers in a dining area with colorful street-scene murals and finally the restaurant's green storefront exterior.
